cohort: 6501 children who were followed up for respiratory diseases at age 2 years, from a baseline cohort of 6640 infants recruited between January 2018 and December 2019.
finding: Cesarean section was found to have both short-term and long-term effects on the risk of asthma and wheezing in children, with an increased risk observed both before and after the age of 2.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was found to increase the risk of asthma and wheezing in children.
